name: IC Sensor — ST
description: A collection of 3 surface-mount IC sensors using ST package footprints, including audio and distance sensors such as MP45DT02, VL53L0CXV0DH1, and VL53L1CXV0FY1.
selection_hints: Requiring surface-mount audio or distance IC sensors in ST footprints.
Matching specific footprints like ST_VL53L1x or ST_HLGA-6_3.76x4.72mm_P1.65mm.
Choosing Tier A KiCad sensor parts like MP45DT02, VL53L0CXV0DH1, or VL53L1CXV0FY1.
avoid_when: Through-hole mounting is required instead of surface-mount.
The PCB design requires footprint packages outside the ST family.
Components other than the specified ST sensor footprints are needed.
